title: Overview of CHIP 2026 Shared Task 1: Patient-Specific Phenotype Concept Recognition in Full-Text Biomedical Literature
abstract: arXiv:2610.29606v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automatic phenotype information extraction plays an important role in rare disease diagnosis, genotype-phenotype analysis, and precision medicine. However, accurately identifying phenotype concepts and determining their associations with specific patients remain challenging, particularly in full-text biomedical articles involving multiple patients and complex clinical descriptions. This paper presents an overview of CHIP 2026 Shared Task 1, which aims to promote the development of methods for patient-specific phenotype concept recognition from full-text biomedical literature. The task consists of two subtasks: full-text phenotype concept recognition and patient-specific phenotype association. For this evaluation, we used 200 annotated full-text biomedical articles from the PatientPheX dataset, containing 506 patients, 15,193 phenotype mentions, and 5,656 patient-phenotype associations. translated_title: CHIP 2026共享任务1概述：全文生物医学文献中的患者特异性表型概念识别
translated_abstract: 自动表型信息抽取在罕见病诊断、基因型-表型分析和精准医疗中发挥着重要作用。然而，准确识别表型概念并确定其与特定患者的关联仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在涉及多名患者和复杂临床描述的全文生物医学文章中。本文对CHIP 2026共享任务1进行了概述，该任务旨在推动从全文生物医学文献中进行患者特异性表型概念识别方法的发展。该任务包含两个子任务：全文表型概念识别和患者特异性表型关联。在本次评测中，我们使用了来自PatientPheX数据集的200篇经标注的全文生物医学文章，其中包含506名患者、15,193个表型提及和5,656个患者-表型关联。共有455支团队报名参加了此次竞赛。
tldr: 本文概述了CHIP 2026共享任务1，该任务基于PatientPheX数据集的200篇标注全文文献，设置全文表型概念识别与患者特异性表型关联两个子任务，以推动从全文生物医学文献中自动识别表型概念及其患者关联方法的发展。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an overview of CHIP 2026 Shared Task 1, which promotes the development of patient-specific phenotype concept recognition methods from full-text biomedical literature, evaluated on 200 annotated articles from the PatientPheX dataset containing 506 patients and 15,193 phenotype mentions.
